name: codex-telegram-plugin
description: Control Codex sessions, answer questions, and approve actions through a standalone Telegram receiver or a compatible external receiver.

interface.shortDescription: Codex remote control through shared or standalone Telegram
interface.longDescription: Adds Telegram question, approval, completion, status, and session-resume support, plus optional Hermes integration. Run the bundled single-poller receiver, or connect an operator-managed external receiver implementing this plugin's protocols.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Codex Telegram integration for questions and approvals while you work.
